title: Agent Vinod
desc: Agent Vinod uncovers a chilling truth: his colleague's death was orchestrated by a powerful business elite. As tensions rise, he must navigate danger to seek justice and uncover the conspiracy.

title: The Sabarmati Report
desc: A Hindi reporter struggles with a deadly fact when a train full of Karsewaks is set ablaze in Godhra. Years later, he is asked to help expose the Sabarmati Incident backed by a buried report.

title: Goodbye
desc: A family unravels after the sudden death of the mother. As the children rush home for her final rites, clashing opinions ignite tensions, exposing deep-rooted conflicts.

title: Haqeeqat
desc: A platoon fighting the Sino-Indian war of 1962 is presumed dead in the hilly terrains of Ladakh but is rescued by tribals. Captain Bahadur Singh and Angmo hold the fort so the platoon can fall back.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: The Bhootnii
desc: Heartbroken Shantanu seeks true love under the Virgin Tree, but things spiral when Mohabbat, a lovestruck ghost, begins obsessing over him and turns his life upside down.

title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
desc: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the man Reena is set to marry, in an attempt to win her love - but he's unprepared for the chaos that follows when the truth comes out.

title: Joggers Park
desc: Jenny, a confident and independent 30-year-old woman, sees her life suddenly change when a former judge falls in love with her, challenging her beliefs and outlook.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Muqabala (1979)
desc: Two feared gangsters declare a truce and strike up an unlikely friendship, but their hard-won peace shatters when both fall for the same woman and refuse to let love go.

title: Jeete Hai Shaan Se
desc: Friends Johny, Govinda, and Iqbal work to serve their community, but when tensions rise between Johny and Govinda, Iqbal intervenes before their greatest enemy exploits the rift.

title: Rock On!!
desc: Four musician friends, torn apart by a misunderstanding, reunite years later to chase the dream they abandoned-rekindling bonds and music on an unforgettable journey.

title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Sarkar 3
desc: Gandhi seeks Sarkar's assistance for a project that will displace people. Sarkar refuses, triggering intense conflicts as power, politics, and betrayal take center stage in this gripping story.
